name: Leilani Baeumer
bio: Leilani completed her BSc and BSc (Hons) in Chemistry at the University of Otago, New Zealand, graduating with first-class honours. Working under Prof. James Crowley, her honours research focused on the design and synthesis of water-soluble Pd(II) metal-organic cages, and she gained further experience in supramolecular chemistry through research internships on Co(III) helicates and carbon-rich container molecules. After gaining industry experience, Leilani joined the Greenfield Group as a PhD student in 2026, where she is investigating helical systems and their light-induced structural behaviour. Outside the lab, Leilani enjoys beach sports, soccer, baking, and teaching.
